```ts
const allFiles: { relPath: string; lines: number }[] = [];

function walk(dir: string, prefix: string) {
  const entries = listDir(dir);
  for (const e of entries) {
    const full = dir + '/' + e.name;
    if (e.kind === "file") {
      const file = readFile(full);
      const lines = file.kind === "text" ? file.totalLines : 0;
      allFiles.push({ relPath: prefix + e.name, lines });
    } else if (e.kind === "directory") {
      walk(full, prefix + e.name + "/");
    }
  }
}

walk("src", "");

// Sort by relative path
allFiles.sort((a, b) => a.relPath.localeCompare(b.relPath));

const manifest = allFiles
  .map(f => `- ${f.relPath} (${f.lines} lines)`)
  .join("\n") + "\n";

writeFile("MANIFEST.md", manifest);
console.log("Wrote MANIFEST.md with", allFiles.length, "files");
```

Now run the shell command to confirm.```ts
const ls = shell("ls -la");
console.log(ls.output);
return { exitCode: ls.exitCode, truncated: ls.truncated };
```
